quest.title: Misplaced Creativity
quest.description: Fontainian researcher Ginette has designed a certain type of robot, but has asked Aino for help due to running into various malfunctions...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Where did I go wrong? If only I had more than theoretical knowledge...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay, no need to confirm this order... This is Ginette, a Fontainian engineer. Of all the orders I got, this one was the most interesting!

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: You're finally here! So there's still hope...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi there! We're Aino's assistants... Or, well, Paimon thinks you can call us that. Whaddya need help with?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: She's made a type of robot that can use kuuvahki to achieve long-distance communication... which sounds super fun! But she's run into a whole bunch of malfunctions, and so she wants me to help her troubleshoot her stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: I'm ashamed to admit that trial-and-error curiosity won't yield any results. In the end, it still boils down to practice...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't sound that hard... Just leave it to us!

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: This is a bit embarrassing, but... I'd like to modify my order. While waiting for your reply, I... Well, I ended up making another mess of things...

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: I was suddenly curious if a change of environment could solve the issue. So I conducted more tests in areas with different kuuvahki concentrations.

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: ...But the malfunctions still happened, and I ended up losing those robots. Sooo... apart from the agreed-upon debugging... Could you help me retrieve the robots as well...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You lost the robots? All of them?

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: If you need me to compensate with extra pay, I'll think of something, I promise!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmm.... But there should be many ways to track them down. Since the robots are all powered by kuuvahki, they should leave behind kuuvahki remnants wherever they go.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I'll prep a special device for you. Once you use it to collect enough kuuvahki remnants, you'll be able to track down whichever robot left 'em behind.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmm-hmm... Well, this sounds fun! And since it does, I won't ask for extra pay!

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Really? Thank you, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Ah, Miss Aino. You're here...

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Aren't you the legendary {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} fairy companion?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know us?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: My name is Sarin, and I'm the Branch Master of Nod-Krai's Adventurers' Guild. Just think about your reputation in the Guild... If I didn't know you, it would be a serious dereliction of my duties, wouldn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, that makes sense!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ah, so you know each other! But lemme just confirm, which order's yours again?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's curious too. What kind of help would the Guild need from Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Well... You know how it is. An adventurer's biggest obstacle out in the wild are the various enemies that stand in their way.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: In other regions, the Guild can collaborate with local authorities to provide some protection for adventurers. But in a place like Nod-Krai, we can only rely on ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: So recently, I've come up with an idea: To design a self-defense device that any adventurer can carry around. That way, even less-skilled adventurers can fend off powerful foes!

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: But... Haha, well, let's just say my attempt ended in failure. And since I lack the talent to get the job done, I may as well hire a professional to help me out.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, that one! It's a good idea, but the design? Yeesh...

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: And that is why we have asked you, Aino... Ah, I mean Miss Aino, for her invaluable assistance!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: The hard part about this one, Sarin, is that the device you've designed uses tech from elsewhere... It can't adapt to Nod-Krai's kuuvahki-rich environments, y'see.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I mean, what we need to do isn't complicated. We just need to use his device, find some bad guys, beat them up for testing, then tweak the design as needed.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And when testing, I'll be able to gather some data about kuuvahki-rich environments! So it's a win-win order.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Buuut, I'm not helping out with the fighting. If the device breaks down when you're surrounded, you'll only have your fists to rely on!

response.speaker: Sarin
response.text: I'll leave it in your capable hands, then. If you need anything, just let me know. The Guild will ensure that your reward for a successful order is most generous!

choices.text: Great. My fists have been itching for some faces.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: You're finally here. You didn't forget about this rare outsourced work opportunity now, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wait, hold on. Which order's yours again?

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: ...I'm Gaudenty, expatriate representative from the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. That should be enough to jog your memory, no?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Too long, didn't hear. Gimme the deets of your order.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: You...! Tch, I'll only say it once more. Recently, a batch of out-of-control recon bots flew out of the Design Bureau, and it's my job to retrieve the wandering units.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: But the robots tend to fly rather high, and handling them alone will prove a tall order. That's why I offered you this opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Gaudenty
dialogues.text: Honestly, you can either retrieve them or destroy them on the spot. Our goal is simply to prevent them from falling into outsiders' hands.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, that one! Yeah, those recon bots can go really, REALLY high, and most ordinary people can't even touch them. But that's why I mastered a way to simply make the Moonlanes we need to get up there.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #You can get the kuuhenki to help out, right, {NICKNAME}? Let's test and see if they can use our Moonlanes and help us take down those recon bots!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No problem! Just leave it to {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Gaudenty
response.text: Oh, right. I'm not going to pay you in Mora. You can take the components of the recon bots as compensation instead.

response.speaker: Gaudenty
response.text: This was stipulated in my order when I placed it, and I don't take retractions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...You're giving us spare parts for payment? Didn't you just say the robots weren't supposed to fall into outsiders' hands?

response.speaker: Gaudenty
response.text: Which is why this is a rare and valuable opportunity for you! If everything goes well, I don't mind turning a blind eye as thanks for your hard work.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's strange. It just sounds like you don't want to pay us...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Well, Mora or no Mora, doesn't matter to me. I want those parts, though. I'm thinking of using them for my future research projects...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, since you're okay with it, Aino...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmm... Should I continue my research or not?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zip-Zap what now?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: To be precise, this is a testing platform for Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1, the latest stealth robot of Aino's design.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: She recently purchased an abandoned cleaning bot from the black market. After modifying it, she created the Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1 you see here today.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This platform has simulated several hostile environments to test the robot's ability to maintain stealth under pressure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why's Aino making this stealth robot again?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: After the theft of Krum-Clank 70% Sweet, Aino made up her mind, and declared: "No matter how powerful the foe, we have to rescue our friends!"

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Then she quickly completed the draft of Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1 and started its development.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: According to her plan, once the development is complete, it should be able to infiltrate even the heavily guarded Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau with ease to rescue our friends.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds pretty awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: But Aino soon realized that perfecting the plan would take far too long — so she wanted to abandon the idea. As per her calculations, it would be much faster to just turn all of Nod-Krai upside down.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I've made up my mind! Since we're taking things nice, chill, and easy, I'll just keep working on Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1! It'll definitely help us save our friends!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: In that case, could we ask you two to assist with the tests?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Based on past statistics, having data provided by other testers as reference will increase Aino's development speed by at least 30%.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Count Paimon in! This sounds like fun!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help too.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Then I thank you both on Aino's behalf. I will grant you access permissions to the platform — from now on, you can use it for any testing you need to conduct.
